# Taylormade Creative

> Taylormade Creative is a Dallas–Fort Worth (DFW) creative agency led by director and designer Nelson Taylor. Its main services are commercial video production, web design, commercial photography, and app design and development for iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac, all made in-house. It also produces corporate video (training and onboarding videos, interview videos, talking-head videos), AI content systems, social media content and live AI/creative workshops, and books photo sessions online with real calendar availability and secure Stripe payment.

Key facts (updated 2026-10-15):
- Based in downtown Dallas, Texas; shoots on location at offices across Dallas–Fort Worth, including Plano, Frisco, Irving, Allen, McKinney, Southlake and Westlake, and travels beyond DFW (recent work includes It’s a Secret Med Spa in Chicago and a destination hair campaign for Juices & Botanics).
- Main services: commercial video production (commercials, brand films, product videos and social ads, quoted on scope), web design (custom websites from $1,200), commercial photography (campaign, beauty and product photography, quoted per project) and app design and development (iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac apps, quoted on scope).
- Led by Nelson Taylor, who also goes by Elliott Taylor (the name on the studio's Instagram, @taylormade_creative). Same person, one studio: 14 years of creative direction and graphic design; has shipped apps to the App Store (Run It UP! Dallas, Taylormade Camera).
- Camera platform: Sony FX6 (cinema video) and Sony A7RV (stills).
- Clients have included TONI&GUY, Neutrogena, Oribe, Foot Locker, Takis, Goldwell, R+Co, KMS, MYX, Black Girl Sunscreen, La Supreme Dallas, Marviano Cosmetics, It’s a Secret Med Spa (Chicago), Juices & Botanics and Pretty Inchez Hair Boutique.
- Films on the homepage (https://www.taylormadecreative.net/#films), each playable in the page: the studio highlight reel; a TONI&GUY Academy recruiting brand film; a TONI&GUY Academy × Plano ISD spot inviting Plano ISD students to apply; It’s a Secret Med Spa (Chicago): a 19-second sale commercial with voiceover; a Juices & Botanics hair campaign shot on location at a tropical lagoon and waterfall; an Oribe product commercial; a Marviano Cosmetics lip gloss campaign shot in Dallas; La Supreme Hair’s poolside campaign and North Dallas grand opening film; and the Mariah.B “Bizness” music video.
- Booking: clients pick a live time slot at https://www.taylormadecreative.net/book/ and pay online; confirmation, shoot-prep, and reminder emails are automatic.
- Digitals sessions (rapid-fire photos for actors/models/creators) are a flat $100, self-booked any day 9am–9pm Central at https://www.taylormadecreative.net/digitals/.
- Corporate team headshots for companies: $125 per person on-site at the client's office anywhere in DFW, or $99 per person at the downtown Dallas studio; 10-person minimum; one retouched headshot per person, back within 5 business days of picks. Add-ons: extra retouched photo $35 each, advanced retouching $25 per photo, background change $15 per photo, rush delivery within 48 hours +25%. Booked by quote (reply within one business day) at https://www.taylormadecreative.net/book/?service=corporate-headshots.
- Custom websites start at $1,200.
- Video production (brand videos, music videos, commercials, event films, corporate training videos, interview videos, talking-head videos, content days, video podcasts) has no flat price: each project is quoted on scope (concept, locations, crew needs, edit complexity), with a reply within one business day.
- Standard terms for quoted projects: 50% deposit locks the date, balance due on shoot day, ~2-week delivery with two rounds of edits, delivered through a private client portal.
- Instant-book sessions need no quote and are self-booked 9am-9pm Central, any day. Headshots $150 (30 min, one look, 3 retouched finals back within 48 hours of your picks) and digitals $100 are paid in full at booking. Senior photos (mini $150: 30 min, 1 look, 3 edited photos; full $350: 1 hour, 2+ looks, 8 edited photos; Downtown Dallas studio or on location anywhere in DFW, same price) are paid in full at booking. Birthday photoshoots have the same two packages: the full $350 shoot is paid in full at booking; the mini $150 shoot takes a $75 deposit, and the other $75 is auto-charged to the same card the day before the shoot.

## Services
- [Video Production](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/video-production/): Dallas–Fort Worth video production: commercials, brand films, product and promo videos, social ads, explainers, music videos, event films. Shoots at your location anywhere in DFW (Dallas, Fort Worth, Arlington, Irving, Grand Prairie, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Denton, Weatherford) or the downtown Dallas studio; travel outside DFW is added to the quote.
- [Corporate Video](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/corporate-video/): corporate video production for Dallas–Fort Worth companies. Training and onboarding videos taught on camera by the company's own experts (new-hire onboarding, how-to and process walkthroughs, product training for sales and support, safety and compliance lessons). Sit-down interview videos with executives, employees, customers and experts: Nelson plans the questions with the client before the shoot and asks them on set, so people answer in their own words instead of reading lines, and every interview is delivered as the full edited interview plus short captioned clips for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. Talking-head videos (leadership and company messages, customer testimonials, explainers, recruiting, social clips). All are shot at your office anywhere in DFW or the downtown Dallas studio; scripted videos include script help and a teleprompter. Also: content days (one shoot day at your location, edited into vertical videos plus a stills bank, built to run for a quarter); video podcasts for companies and creators, recorded in the studio and edited into full episodes plus social clips. Videos come captioned in horizontal and vertical versions with usage rights included; raw footage is available for an extra fee; NDAs signed on request. Travels outside DFW (added to the quote). Quoted per project within one business day.
- [Photography](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/photography/): commercial photography in Dallas. Leads with campaign photography for hair, beauty, skincare and consumer brands (clients include TONI&GUY, Oribe, Neutrogena, Black Girl Sunscreen, Goldwell, MYX, R+Co and KMS), plus beauty and med spa photography, product photography, branding photoshoots and event/runway photography, all art-directed, lit and retouched in-house and quoted within one business day (50% deposit; finals in about two weeks with two rounds of edits). Also bookable online: headshots $150 flat, digitals $100 flat, senior photos and birthday photoshoots from $150, team headshots from $99 per person.
- [Product Photography](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/product-photography/): clean e-commerce on white, styled sets, dark and dramatic, splash and liquid, in-hand and on-model product images, plus campaign creative and a featured Black Girl Sunscreen × The Little Mermaid campaign. Quoted per project within one business day; 50% deposit locks the date; finals in about two weeks with two rounds of edits.
- [Branding Photoshoots](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/branding-photography/): branding photography for beauty, hair and makeup pros, med spas, founders and executives, and fitness, apparel and fashion brands, plus creative/editorial shoots. Downtown Dallas studio, at the client's business, or on location in DFW. Quoted per project within one business day.
- [Headshots](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/headshots/): professional headshots, $150 flat: 30 minutes, one look, 3 retouched finals in 48 hours, self-booked online 9am–9pm daily.
- [Corporate Headshots](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/corporate-headshots/): team headshots for companies, on-site at your office ($125/person) or in the downtown Dallas studio ($99/person), 10-person minimum, one retouched headshot each, editing add-ons from $15. Headshot booths for conferences and company events, quoted per event. Billed for the headcount booked (book 10, 8 show up: billed for 10). Staff who miss the team shoot can be photographed later. Travel outside DFW is added to the quote.
- [Birthday Photoshoots](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/birthday/): Downtown Dallas studio birthday shoots: mini $150 (30 min, 1 look, 3 edited photos) or full $350 (1 hour, 2+ looks, 8 edited photos), self-booked online.
- [Senior Photos](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/senior-photos/): senior photo sessions in the Downtown Dallas studio or on location anywhere in DFW, same price: mini $150 (30 min, 1 look, 3 edited photos) or full $350 (1 hour, 2+ looks, 8 edited photos), paid in full and self-booked online.
- [Digitals](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/digitals/): casting-ready digitals for models, actors, and creators: $100 flat, 30 minutes, bookable online any day 9am–9pm.
- [AI Content & Automation](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/ai-creative/): AI content systems for Dallas–Fort Worth businesses, directed in-house by a creative director with 14 years of brand work: AI brand spokespeople, AI campaign imagery art-directed to the brand guide, automated content engines that draft, schedule and publish on cadence, and AI + film hybrid productions (real footage elevated with AI). Every output gets a human art review, and the client owns all deliverables. Quoted per project within one business day.
- [Web Design](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/web-design/): landing pages to full business websites, from $1,200 (ad landing page $1,200, starter business website $2,000, premium business website $3,500, custom or multi-site from $6,000).
- [App Design](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/app-design/): app design and development for iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac, taken through App Store review. Built Run It UP! Dallas (run club app with GPS-verified check-ins, community chat, events and an Apple Watch companion) and Taylormade Camera (iPhone camera, voice-follow teleprompter and editor), both live on the App Store, plus Taylormade Podcast for Mac (public beta). Quoted on scope within one business day.
- [Social Media Content](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/social-media/): monthly social media content for Dallas–Fort Worth businesses: cinematic reels shot on a cinema rig, designed carousels and statics, and strategy (positioning, hooks, content calendar). One batch shoot day covers the month, the client reviews everything before it posts and owns all of it, and being on camera is optional. Retainers are quoted per project within one business day.
- [Live Workshops & Training](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/workshops/): hands-on AI and creative workshops for teams, schools and organizations, taught live in person anywhere in Dallas–Fort Worth or virtually anywhere. Tracks: Practical AI for Business Teams (people build working automations on their real workflows), AI Content Creation, and Creative Direction Fundamentals. Custom curriculum after a scope call, beginners welcome, single sessions or recurring programs. Quoted per project within one business day.

## Apps
- [Taylormade Podcast for Mac](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/podcast-app/): records a video podcast on up to four cameras and two mics with one Mac, cuts to whoever is talking, and makes a video for YouTube, podcast audio, vertical clips and edit files. Free during the beta; macOS 15 or later.
- [Taylormade Camera for iPhone](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/taylormade-camera/id6789144751): the iPhone camera, voice-follow teleprompter and editor app, with an Apple Watch remote.
- [Studio Rental: Jenel Studios](https://jenelstudios.com/): Taylormade Creative's rental space now operates as Jenel Studios (Instagram @jenelstudios): downtown Dallas natural-light studio, $60/hr weekdays, $75/hr weekends, 4-hour and 8-hour blocks, lighting add-ons, no cameras on site.

## Guides
- [What headshots cost in Dallas (2026)](https://www.taylormadecreative.net/headshots/cost/): a standard Dallas studio headshot session typically runs $150–$450 (Photography Shark, May 2026); Taylormade Creative's is $150 flat.
- [What it costs to rent a photo studio in Dallas (2026)](https://jenelstudios.com/studio-rental-cost/): Dallas photo studios average about $90/hr (Peerspace) to $129/hr (Tagvenue); Jenel Studios is $60/hr weekdays, $75/hr weekends.
